subject: Proposal: Move pilot to asynchronous track (Novablue)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Holt <emma@novablue.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Move pilot to asynchronous track (Novablue)

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for agreeing to a pilot with Redwood. I know your execs are traveling this week and that the original 30-min architecture review for Monday will be hard to keep. Rather than try to squeeze a live session that risks another no-show, I wanted to propose switching the pilot to an asynchronous track so your team can progress on your schedule.

High-level idea:
- We’ll provide a short recorded walkthrough (15 min) that covers the reference integration and security posture.
- A lightweight runbook and a small sandbox model seed so your engineers can validate against your datasets.
- Weekly 30-min office hours (optional) for live questions — can be recorded.

Benefits for you: preserves momentum without exec calendar coordination, and still gives your SREs/Platform team a chance to validate performance.

If that sounds like a fit, I can:
1) Share the pilot pack and a short recording by EOD Monday (attached outline).
2) Open a shared spreadsheet with suggested async tasks and acceptance criteria.
3) Book one optional office hours slot next week — I’ll propose a few times.

If you’d still prefer a live walk-through, I’m happy to propose windows later in May once travel clears.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128
